description: This Java source file defines the ResolutionHelper class, which provides methods for managing dependency resolution among batch requests in the Apache Fineract project. It includes internal classes for representing request dependency trees and methods for building these trees, resolving request dependencies, and updating request payloads and URLs based on prior responses.

classes.name: ResolutionHelper
classes.description: A service class for managing dependency resolution among batch requests in Fineract. It allows building a dependency tree of requests and resolving dependencies by updating request bodies and URLs based on prior responses.

classes.name: ResolutionHelper.BatchRequestNode
classes.description: A node class used to represent individual batch requests and their dependency children in a tree structure.

methods.name: buildNodesTree
methods.description: Constructs a tree of BatchRequestNodes representing dependencies, starting from a list of BatchRequests.

methods.name: addDependingRequest
methods.description: Recursively attaches a BatchRequest as a child node to its parent node based on request references.

methods.name: resolveRequest
methods.description: Resolves dependencies for a given BatchRequest against a parent BatchResponse, updating request body and URL based on previous response data.

methods.name: resolveDependentVariables
methods.description: Resolves dependencies within JSON elements, replacing placeholders with actual values from responses.

methods.name: processJsonObject
methods.description: Processes a JSON object, resolving dependencies within its fields.

methods.name: processJsonArray
methods.description: Processes a JSON array, resolving dependencies recursively within its elements.

methods.name: processJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Processes a JSON primitive value, resolving special placeholders to actual data from previous responses.
